text:
alex: Quick post-all-hands follow-up — consolidating Qs, clarifications, and action owners from today. I'll keep this short and editable. Links at the bottom.

maria: Appreciate this — can you confirm the Dedicated SLA GA date?

alex: Confirmed: target GA is May 15. That date is still contingent on the final infra perf tests next week. Owner: @drew (will post the canary plan).

drew: Working with eng-sre on the canary checklist. Plan to run 3 region canaries, then a 48h stability window. I’ll share the checklist by Tue.

jamal: For customers asking about private deployment docs — is there a migration guide?

alex: Short answer: yes. We have a migration draft; needs security review. Owner for publishing: @rachel. ETA: end of this sprint.

leah: On routing policies Q — leadership said a policy UI is coming. Any timeline?

alex: Policy UI alpha is scheduled for the June sprint. We will push a feature flag to Redwood Console for internal testing first.

maria: Can we get clarity on pricing changes mentioned? Heard "cost-aware controls" — will invoices change?

alex: No immediate billing schema change. We’re rolling out unit-cost telemetry and a new cost breakdown in Console this quarter. Any billing model changes would be a separate announcement and discussed with sales.

jamal: Re: evals and regressions — is there a way to opt into auto-alerts for quality regressions?

alex: Yes — Redwood Optimize will support alerting on eval regressions tied to prompt sets. Beta signups coming next week. Owner: @leah to coordinate beta invites.

rachel: Quick note on compliance packages: we’ll publish the SOC2 audit summary doc to the partner portal once legal signs off. ETA: 2 weeks.

ops-bot: Deploy notice: infra-runner/2026-03-20-3 started canary tests in us-west-2.

drew: Adding a short checklist here (will paste to eng-sre channel too):
```
- Run canaries in 3 regions
- Validate latency SLOs for p50/p95
- Check KV cache hit rates > 60%
- Run perf tests at scaled QPS for 2 hours
- Smoke test failover and fallback policies
```

maria: Thanks — can we also link the slides + recording?

alex: Slides: https://redwood.company/slides/ah-mar-2026.pdf Recording: https://video.redwood/company/ah-mar-2026 (internal access).

jamal: Action items I own: migrate private-deploy migration checklist to docs repo, + coordinate security review with legal.

rachel: I'll own publishing SOC2 summary and the customer-facing compliance FAQ.

leah: I’ll run the Optimize beta invites and assemble an initial eval set for the infra team.

drew: I’ll post canary checklist in eng-sre by Tue, and update this thread when it’s live.

alex: Summary of immediate action items (owners):
- Drew: canary checklist + rollout plan (ETA Tue)
- Rachel: SOC2 summary + compliance FAQ (ETA 2w)
- Jamal: private-deploy migration doc + security review (ETA end of sprint)
- Leah: Optimize beta invites & eval set (ETA next week)

alex: If you have minor clarifications, reply here. For big blockers, please ping me or your manager directly. Thanks all! :clap:

maria: One tiny ask — can the slides include a short one-liner for platform teams about "how to request Dedicated"?

alex: Good idea. Adding a "How to request Dedicated" slide and a short checklist for sales/PS. Will update slides and repost.

jamal: noted — will surface any migration questions from customers once rachel publishes compliance doc.

rachel: tagging legal for signoff cadence: @legal-team please advise on SOC2 summary timeline.

ops-bot: Reminder: team retro scheduled Thu 10:00 in #all-hands-retros.

alex: Closing thread for updates — I’ll bump when docs/links are updated. If you want edit access to this thread summary, ping me and I’ll add you.
